_comment: Grip poses of the hammer style (G6c: Benika's iron club, two-handed; G5 builds the style's animations on them). The left hand holds the handle 2.6 px behind the right (solved on the teen form). Conventions in tools/herogen/anim/poses.py.

hammer.stance._comment: The shoulder carry: feet apart, knees bent, the club resting on the right shoulder pointing up and back, both hands on the handle in front of the right shoulder.

hammer.raise._comment: The overhead wind-up: the club raised behind the head with both hands, the chest arched back.

hammer.slam._comment: The slam at the moment it lands: bent forward, both arms down and forward, the club's head on the ground in front.
